data.summary: Financial Services professional with 8+ years of experience across Regulatory Reporting, Financial Reporting, Fund Operations and Collateral Management within global financial services environments. Hands-on experience in SEC regulatory reporting for N-MFP, N-PORT and N-CEN, supporting investment fund reporting through journal entries, portfolio holdings, reconciliation, risk metrics, liquidity classification, asset allocation and fund-level disclosures. Experienced in Money Market Fund reporting, including validation of security-level holdings, NAV, daily/weekly liquidity levels, WAM calculations, derivatives exposure, credit and interest-rate risk metrics, and investment portfolio data. Hands-on experience using BlackRock Aladdin to extract portfolio and derivatives holding reports for reconciliation with internal data, and Alteryx templates for automation of Excel-based console activities. Experienced in Team Leadership, including allocation and review of daily BAU activities for a team of 4, coordination with onshore teams and clients, and responding to client and auditor queries. Earlier experience includes financial reporting under US GAAP/IFRS and OTC derivatives collateral management.

raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
J.P. Morgan Chase & Co. — Mumbai Team Leader – Regulatory Reporting / Financial Reporting | April 2022 – June 2026
SEC Regulatory Reporting
Led/supporting preparation and review of SEC regulatory reports including N-MFP, N-PORT and N-CEN for investment
funds.
Worked on N-MFP reporting for Money Market Funds, including validation of security-level holdings such as issuer name,
maturity date and credit rating.
Performed validation of NAV and daily/weekly liquidity levels and supported Weighted Average Maturity (WAM)
calculations for Money Market Fund reporting.
Worked on N-PORT reporting, including Chart of Accounts reconciliation, journal entries, portfolio holdings reports and
risk metrics.
Supported N-PORT reporting covering asset allocation, credit risk, interest-rate risk and derivatives exposure. • Performed validation of liquidity classification and ASC 820-related reporting information. • Worked on reporting of portfolio activities involving restricted securities, defaulted securities, collateral, repo/reverse repo and securities on loan.
Supported N-CEN (Census Report) reporting covering fund type and structure, service providers, shareholder information,
securities lending activities, fees and expenses.
Used BlackRock Aladdin to extract portfolio holdings and derivatives reports and reconcile them against internal data. • Used Alteryx templates to support automation of Excel-based console activities and reduce manual effort. • Performed variance/reconciliation checks to identify discrepancies between source data and internal reporting data. • Participated in UAT/JIRA testing for reporting-related automation and system enhancements. • Coordinated with onshore teams and clients to resolve reporting queries and operational issues. • Reviewed and responded to client and auditor comments, ensuring appropriate investigation and resolution. • Managed daily BAU activities and provided task oversight for a team of 4, including work allocation and review of completed tasks.
Financial Reporting
Prepared and reviewed Portfolio of Investments and financial statements, including Balance Sheet, P&L and Cash Flow
statements.
Performed adjustments to cost, market value and NAV of investments to align with Trial Balance. • Conducted inter-consistency checks across financial statements, FAS 157 and FAS 161 tables, affiliate tables, footnotes and client-specific disclosures.
Reviewed day-to-day activities in accordance with SOPs and agreed client deadlines and SLAs. • Liaised with partner sites to coordinate external deliveries and communicate reporting status. • Identified opportunities for process improvement and recommended changes to improve operational efficiency.
Ernst & Young LLP — Mumbai Project Consultant – Financial Reporting | September 2021 – March 2022
Prepared Annual, Semi-Annual and quarterly/NQ reports for clients. • Supported preparation of Portfolio of Investments for investment funds. • Worked with investment data covering derivatives including Futures, Forwards, Swaps and Options. • Prepared portfolio and currency abbreviation glossaries to support financial reporting activities. • Performed report-running activities for Annual, Semi-Annual and NQ fund reporting cycles.
SS&C GlobeOp Financial Services — Mumbai Senior Associate – Collateral Management | June 2017 – April 2021
Managed OTC derivative collateral and margin call activities for hedge fund clients under ISDA arrangements. • Sent daily margin calls to counterparties through Acadia or manual email processes, based on agreed client/counterparty requirements.
Reconciled portfolios and reviewed MTM calculations to agree or dispute margin calls received from counterparties. • Prepared wires for agreed margin calls on a daily or T+1 basis, according to counterparty and client requirements. • Performed daily cash flow and collateral booking activities and reconciled amounts received or paid against internal records.
Identified and analyzed trends and recurring patterns in outstanding unmatched breaks within portfolios. • Provided break analysis to clients to support investigation and resolution of recurring reconciliation issues.
LEADERSHIP & STAKEHOLDER MANAGEMENT
Managed daily BAU work allocation and task review for a team of 4. • Coordinated with onshore teams and clients to resolve operational and reporting queries. • Reviewed client requirements and supported timely resolution of operational issues. • Responded to client and auditor comments, coordinating internally to provide appropriate responses. • Supported knowledge sharing and maintained quality across team deliverables.
Certified Investment Banking Operations Professional – Imarticus Learning | 2016–2017
Covered: Securities and Derivatives | End-to-End Trade Life Cycle of Listed and OTC Products | Clearing & Settlement Systems | AML/KYC | Asset Management | Risk Management
